name: Mobilum Technologies Inc.
summary: Mobilum Technologies Inc. is a financial technology firm that offers payment processing services across Europe and North America. The company specializes in user-friendly ("plug-and-play") gateway and payment technology, facilitating the conversion of traditional currencies into cryptocurrencies. These solutions cater to a range of clients in the digital asset sector, including exchanges, wallet providers, brokers, and liquidity providers. A key offering includes "on-ramp" and "off-ramp" capabilities, allowing individuals to effortlessly buy and sell cryptocurrencies using their credit and debit cards. Headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, the company was established in 2010 and officially adopted the name Mobilum Technologies Inc. in July 2021, having previously been known as TechX Technologies Inc.
